meta.title: Moonbroom Derby
meta.instructions: Tap the left or right side to swerve your broom between lanes. Dodge storm clouds and runaway spellbooks, grab sparks to build a streak, and skim past hazards for Whoosh points. Cross the finish lanterns in 50 seconds.

do.value: {id: haz_seq, x: lane_x(a), y: -36.0, lane: a, kind: if is_book then 'book' else 'cloud', passed: false, born: now}

then.value: {id: haz_seq, x: lane_x(b), y: -36.0, lane: b, kind: 'cloud', passed: false, born: now}

do.to: map(hazards, h => {...h, y: h.y + speed * event.dt / 1000.0, x: if h.kind == 'book' then lane_x(h.lane) + 30.0 * sin((now - h.born) / 240.0) else h.x})

rules.when: any(hazards, h => not h.passed and h.y > player.y + 12.0)

let.close: filter(hazards, h => not h.passed and h.y > player.y + 12.0 and abs(h.x - player.x) < 80.0 and now >= safe_until)

do.to: map(hazards, h => if not h.passed and h.y > player.y + 12.0 then {...h, passed: true} else h)

do.value: {id: pop_seq, x: (c.x + player.x) / 2.0, y: player.y - 34.0, born: now, text: 'Whoosh +5'}
{id: pop_seq, x: player.x, y: player.y - 46.0, born: now, text: '+' + str(10 + 5 * combo)}

template.rotation: = if h.kind == 'book' then 10.0 * cos((now - h.born) / 240.0) else sin((now + h.id * 137) / 380.0) * 5.0

art.style: Wizard-academy night race: indigo sky with a crescent moon, castle spires with warm windows, a plum-cloaked rider with an orange scarf, slate storm clouds with pink lightning, crimson flapping spellbooks and mint sparks.
